environment.endpoint: QEMU e1000e 8086:10d3 behind a PCIe root port

guestReboot.phasePersistence: UEFI variable in the VMware VM NVRAM

inference: Guest reboot with real traffic before and after the reboot is supported in this nested DirectPath profile.
ESXi exposed a legacy INTx route and the guest driver selected it, but this nested DirectPath endpoint did not deliver functional traffic or interrupts.
The same QEMU e1000e and pci=nomsi probe works when booted directly under QEMU, so the failure is scoped to the nested DirectPath path, not to the probe or the base e1000e INTx model.
Do not generalize this nested failure to physical ESXi hardware; keep MSI-X/MSI as the parity baseline and require E4 hardware evidence before claiming INTx compatibility.
